source_cards.title: A Multi-Resolution Spectrogram Approach for Estimating the Physical Parameters of a Plate Reverb
source_cards.publication: DAFx 2026 Parameter Estimation Challenge, Task A
source_cards.method: ResNet-18 over three magnitude-spectrogram resolutions plus one relative-phase channel; submitted variant downsampled the IR to emphasize low-modal-overlap resonances.
source_cards.limited_conclusion: Relative phase helped resolve controlled output-location ambiguity and physically informed band selection improved the synthetic challenge estimator.

source_cards.title: Audio-to-Audio via Diffusion Warm Initialization
source_cards.method: Guide-signal warm initialization of reverse diffusion; FAD and pitch-set Jaccard distance used for realism/faithfulness analysis; examples in timbre transfer, MIDI-to-real and enhancement.
source_cards.limited_conclusion: Initialization time, guidance and noise are model-specific controls; the reported Stable Audio Open operating point is not a transferable mixing setting.
reported_failures: unwanted sources often persist or become artificial

deduplicated_sources: DAFx26 Diagonal Complex SSM plate reverb

knowledge_cards.claim: Relative phase can reduce magnitude-symmetry ambiguity in controlled plate-IR output-location estimation.
Physically informative low-modal-overlap bands can outperform full bandwidth for plate-parameter estimation.
Plate-challenge NMSE is not evidence of better sounding reverb or better mixes.
Diffusion initialization time is a model-specific realism/faithfulness control, not a transferable mixing preset.
FAD plus pitch-set distance leaves transient, spatial, groove, source-identity and arrangement preservation unmeasured.
Warm initialization alone is not a reliable separator; percussive leakage may persist or become synthetic artifacts.
Official metadata without transcript/content does not make a YouTube video studied.

candidate_rules.title: Phase-channel gate for plate-IR estimator research
candidate_rules.apply_when: Evaluating a plate physical-parameter estimator on the same open challenge distribution or a separately validated real-IR extension.
candidate_rules.change: Relative-phase feature channel absent versus present with magnitude inputs and low-band preprocessing fixed.

candidate_rules.title: Model-specific gate for diffusion warm initialization
candidate_rules.apply_when: Research-only evaluation of a pinned rights-cleared diffusion model on project-owned audio; never automatic cleanup or source suppression.
candidate_rules.change: One initialization control at a time; do not copy tau_init approximately 0.8 outside the reported Stable Audio Open setup.

experiments.A: pinned model and initialization time with lambda=0
